Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for consideration by the Rental Housing Board by sending them
to the Rental Housing Board Secretary at rentalhousingboard@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Rental Housing Board prior to consideration of the
agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please identify the agenda number and/or subject matter. Correspondence should
indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public hearings will be made part of the official public record of the meeting.
Contact the Office of the Housing Protection Board at (310) 412 - 4330 with any questions.

ACCESSIBILITY : If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the
Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related
modification or accommodation, or translation services in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable modification, accommodation, or service by
contacting the Housing Protection Department by telephone at 310 - 412- 4330, FAX at 310- 412- 4276, One Manchester Boulevard, Suite 602, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA
90301 or via email to rentalhousingboard@cityofinglewood.org no later than 48 hours prior to the scheduled meeting.
